title: IVG Pro 12 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Pink Lemonade IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods combine sweet mixed berries with a bright citrus twist. It’s a fruity blend that’s zesty and vibrant, with a sparkling character on the exhale that keeps each puff fresh and light. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the refill system keeps the pod automatically topped up as you vape — supporting up to 10,000 puffs per kit, with no refilling or coil swaps needed. Designed for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pod uses mesh coil technology to ensure consistently smooth MTL vapour and clear flavour. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
